An improved inelastic x-ray scattering technique helps clarify the connections between complex vibrations and the properties of glasses.


[Phys. Rev. X 16, 021021] Published Tue Apr 28, 2026.
tldr: This paper studies low-frequency vibrations in vapor-deposited glasses using inelastic x-ray scattering, focusing on the effect of glass stability.
motivation: Understanding the vibrational properties of glasses is important for their mechanical and thermal behavior, but this work does not connect to quantum information or thermodynamics.
method: Improved inelastic x-ray scattering technique was used to measure low-frequency vibrations in vapor-deposited glasses with varying stability.
result: The study clarifies the relationship between glass stability and low-frequency vibrational modes.
conclusion: The findings provide insights into glass physics but have no direct relevance to the user's research interests in quantum information, thermodynamics, networks, or hybrid systems.

title: Breakdown Of The Thermodynamic Limit In Quantum Spin And Dimer Models
authors: Jeet Shah, Laura Shou, Jeremy Shuler, And Victor Galitski
abstract:
Author(s): Jeet Shah, Laura Shou, Jeremy Shuler, and Victor Galitski

Geometry-induced quantum phase separation in quantum dimer models demonstrates that domain shape can fundamentally alter macroscopic ground states, challenging traditional assumptions about the thermodynamic limit.


[Phys. Rev. X 16, 021020] Published Mon Apr 27, 2026.
tldr: This paper studies geometry-induced quantum phase separation in quantum dimer models, challenging the thermodynamic limit.
motivation: To understand how domain shape can alter macroscopic ground states in quantum dimer models, questioning the validity of the thermodynamic limit.
method: Analytical and numerical analysis of quantum dimer models on lattices with specific geometries.
result: Demonstrates that the shape of the domain can fundamentally change the ground state, leading to a breakdown of the thermodynamic limit.
conclusion: The thermodynamic limit may not hold in certain quantum spin and dimer models due to geometry-induced phase separation.

title: Excitations Across The Equilibrium And Photoinduced “Hidden” States Of Magnetoresistive Manganites
authors: Shiyu Fan, Feng Jin, Taehun Kim, Umesh Kumar, Zixun Zhang, Vivek Bhartiya, Jiemin Li, Brandon Yalin, Yanhong Gu, Mingqiang Gu, Wen Hu, Claudio Mazzoli, G. Lawrence Carr, Osor S. Barišić, Andrey S. Mishchenko, Valentina Bisogni, Sobhit Singh, Wenbin Wu, And Jonathan Pelliciari
